summary: Tested iteration-16 targeted changes: admin calendar click-to-book, premium PublicBookingPage redesign, and backend public-endpoint filtering by visible_online/bookable_online. Backend visibility filters PASS. Admin calendar click-to-book and bold borders PASS. Public booking premium aesthetic PASS. CRITICAL regression: public booking availability endpoint returns zero slots for every date and every staff, breaking end-to-end public booking beyond step 3.

critical.issue: Returns empty slots with message 'Staff not available on this day' for ALL days for ALL staff. Root cause: line 2228 server.py checks day_schedule.get('enabled', False) but staff.working_hours in DB stores {start, end, breaks} per day with NO 'enabled' key. Default False -> every weekday is treated as 'not working'. This breaks the entire public booking flow on step 3.

ui_bugs.issue: Half-hour and hour slot buttons have no z-index, while appointment blocks have z-index:5. When a week slot overlaps an existing appointment cell, clicking the slot opens the appointment detail dialog instead of opening New Booking. Workaround: click empty cells only. Add z-index>5 on empty slot buttons OR move appointment block only over the occupied rows.

integration_issues.issue: Date picker on Step 3 shows all future dates as disabled/greyed (calendar has no selectable dates) because availability API returns empty slots for every day. Cannot proceed to Details/Confirm. Blocks all public bookings for all tenants.

action_items: FIX BACKEND: In /api/public/booking/{slug}/availability (server.py ~line 2225-2229) treat presence of 'start' and 'end' keys as enabled. Recommended change: `if not day_schedule or not day_schedule.get('start') or not day_schedule.get('end'): return empty slots`. Alternatively migrate the seeded staff.working_hours to include enabled=true per day.

FIX CALENDAR Z-INDEX: Give WeekGrid/DayView slot buttons a z-index lower than appointment blocks but ensure empty-area clicks still reach slot buttons. Current issue: appointments (z-5) intercept clicks on slot buttons behind them. Consider rendering slots in a separate layer with pointer-events-none on appointment OR only render slot buttons in gaps between appointments.
ADD data-testid='service-card-{id}' alias if test suite expects it (currently only 'service-{id}' exists).

rca_of_the_issue: SCHEMA MISMATCH BETWEEN SEED AND RUNTIME: Staff documents in MongoDB have working_hours of shape {monday: {start, end, breaks}, ...} (no 'enabled' flag). The public availability endpoint at /api/public/booking/{slug}/availability in server.py checks `day_schedule.get('enabled', False)` and defaults to False when missing, causing every day of the week to be treated as non-working. Result: calendar on the public booking page has all dates greyed out and step 3 cannot progress. Mitigation: (a) treat presence of start+end as enabled, OR (b) migrate seed data to include enabled:true per day. Option (a) is backwards compatible and recommended.
